result.title: CrownFusion: 3D Dental Crown Generation Using Geometry Images and Latent Diffusion
result.comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026. 11 pages, 6 figures. Equal contribution: J. Z. Ye and X. Yan. Project page: https://crownfusion.github.io/
result.summary: We introduce CrownFusion, a latent diffusion model to generate 3D dental crown designs from geometry images, a 2D-grid encoding of surface coordinates. Departing from traditional approaches that use point clouds, our "CrownImage" representation not only unlocks the full power of image-based generative architectures, but also preserves fine geometric detail by operating at far higher spatial resolutions than point clouds to alleviate smoothing artifacts in the 3D generation. Conditioned on jointly learned embeddings of the surrounding dentition, our probabilistic diffusion model produces anatomically plausible crowns with morphological variations tailored to individual patient cases. To accommodate multiple valid designs, we propose an occlusal fit metric based on proximity to the antagonist teeth. We evaluate our method through quantitative experiments and qualitative studies involving expert testimonials. We also release the FDI 16 Crown Dataset, comprising 11,513 annotated intra-oral scans, to support future research in dental CAD.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 CrownFusion，用几何图像（CrownImage）编码牙冠表面坐标，并以潜空间扩散模型在邻牙嵌入条件下生成个体化 3D 牙冠设计，同时给出咬合契合度指标并发布牙科数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于牙科 CAD 的 3D 形状生成应用，虽有 latent diffusion 与几何图像编码，但无视觉推理状态、证据获取、停止决策或 latent 内容使用与监督方面的联系，故排除。
